meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first.
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.

A machine's guess, and Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student. Your school's procedure 4.3 says the same thing, and I have it printed in my bag. So I gave him a zero, you said: what else did you have, and did anyone hear Owen first?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record.
What moved her: nothing, because no dated document tied to Owen's own work was shown.
What cost ground: leading with the detector score as the whole reason for the zero, because she distrusts software and the school's own procedure says detection results alone don't establish a concern.
Try next time: in your first reply, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then show her a dated record of Owen's own work that she can check herself, instead of the checker's score.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
